<h2>Build One sjSDM Candidate-Fold Result</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Constructs one typed tuning row and its compact prediction-cache record for
a completed or failed candidate lifecycle.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_candidate_fold_result(
  data_candidate = NULL,
  list_fold_context = NULL,
  fit_seed = NA_integer_,
  score_seed = NA_integer_,
  fit_status = NULL,
  error_message = NA_character_,
  data_metrics = NULL,
  data_predicted = NULL,
  fit_seconds = NA_real_,
  prediction_seconds = NA_real_,
  scoring_seconds = NA_real_
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate">data_candidate</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row candidate table with the candidate identifier and six parameters.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_fold_context">list_fold_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fold context containing identifiers, sizes, and the CV strategy.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_seed">fit_seed</code>, <code id="score_seed">score_seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Derived candidate seeds, or typed missing integers before candidate work.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_status">fit_status</code></td>
<td>
<p>One of 'preparation_error', 'fit_error', 'prediction_error',
'scoring_error', or 'ok'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="error_message">error_message</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character failure message, or a missing character value for success.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_metrics">data_metrics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional named list of the five candidate scoring metrics.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_predicted">data_predicted</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional held-out probability matrix. Fitted model objects are never stored.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fit_seconds">fit_seconds</code>, <code id="prediction_seconds">prediction_seconds</code>, <code id="scoring_seconds">scoring_seconds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate lifecycle timings in seconds.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing one-row 'data_tuning' and 'list_prediction'.
</p>

</main>
